plugins.name: positioning
plugins.description: A 15-minute forced-choice positioning session for startups. Pick a category path, define who you ignore, write a sub-30-word positioning statement, find your mind-virus phrase, and plan a 90-day window of proof. Co-founders run it solo; the skill compiles their answers and forces the tiebreaks.
